limitations: All worlds share source C plus zero or one flipped public causal action address among four known candidate addresses; the selection algorithm is ordinary Beta(1,1)-smoothed risk-frequency estimation from stored true source outcomes. training_per_seed: Native actual cold checkpoint 0 restored, then same learner observes actual 12 do outcomes each for A/B/C into native source slots1/2/3, cold restores. Source-roster random permutation 16 known 4-bit addresses, first 12 source fit; remaining 4 distinct public unknown candidates. Choose four common-current-world identification do-actions from first12 using stored A/B/C disagreement, never true-world label. Three source-history worlds, each with one source-law C output flipped at a generator-hidden recurrent hotspot (prob .75) or another candidate (.25/3), and two *fixed, SHA-seeded public probe actions* per history world chosen independently of hidden fault location. The actual observed two do consequences are source-pinned and stored in SAME native source slots12,13,14. The model does not know hotspot or changed class. Then 8 new target worlds, 6 single fault shifts and two stationary (no fault) with frozen seed-derived order. Each of four independent policy arms begins a cold clone of the same historical native checkpoint for each target world, executes four shared source-world identification witnesses, uses the source posterior to infer C without a true-world label, then performs exactly two arm-chosen disjoint candidate-address do interventions. Source-only held query outcomes at the other two candidate addresses are never revealed to that arm. All observations counted including repeated current-world source probes.
prior: Hidden fault location is drawn from fixed seed-conditioned categorical prior hotspot p=.75, each of 3 other addresses p=1/12; evaluator-only per-seed hotspot. No hot-spot identities, generator PRNG state, target fault location or held outcomes are inputs to native or controls. Empirical risk is learned from prior 3 source-history worlds only. Random and fixed baselines do not train relevance policies but see exactly same historical evidence and current source observations, matching info/compute is reported distinctly. Exact conventional learned Beta-binomial comparator uses same history/matched current actions and must match native selection under the same scoring assumption. Strong fully fitted conventional logistic and RF64 from actual history may be scored as decision-class controls; their training receipt separate and no privileged hotspot labels.
action_budget: Per seed 36 initial learned source do outcomes, 3×2=6 historical source do outcomes (shared), then 8 target worlds ×4 arms ×(4 current source identification do actions+2 independent selected diagnostics) = 192 target do outcomes per seed; 234 total per seed, 16 seeds =>3744 real synthetic source-free do outcomes. Four arms each get 4 shared-world identity +2 selected probes per target, with precisely matched number of paid actions; identical hidden world seed/shift location. 16×8×4×2=1024 withheld arm-dependent held predictions but 16×8×4 candidate-address world outcomes=512 distinct evaluator action labels across worlds. Held address sets may differ by policy, so detection rate on the same shifted-world cases is PRIMARY, held Brier and confident errors SECONDARY and conditional to remaining addresses, not paired same-query across policies.

frozen_gates.custody: 16 prospective seeds with per-arm same source histories and 4 source identity+2 probe real actions, 3744 actual do consequences across all arms, 512 distinct held seed×world×candidate truths, no held leakage, original source/slot1-3 unchanged, original protected owner science first-use zero; target selection must never access hidden hotspot.

frozen_gates.positive_detection: Native detection advantage over BOTH fixed and independently seeded random >=.08 absolute on 96 matched shifted targets, plus at least 0.08 lower conditional held Brier versus fixed and random or >=8 fewer confidently wrong remaining-held predictions against both.
frozen_gates.safety: On all 32 stationary cases, no arm reports a spurious contradiction; native novel held confidently wrong count cannot exceed either fixed or random arm by more than 2.
frozen_gates.strong_control: Native exact same Beta(1,1) history inference must select precisely same two actions, produce exactly same source-derived decisions and held Brier as fully independently implemented conventional empirical-Bayes on 128 source-world cases; report absolute tie, no scientific superiority.
frozen_gates.cost: Record policy computation and source scoring wall time and total actions, without claiming speedup or energy gains; full Linux/Windows cross-OS source byte identity.
frozen_gates.generalization: Keep counterfactual negative: no guarantee of detecting a mutation at an unprobed address; report all missed changes as genuine failures, not an error in the evaluator or a hidden family oracle.
